The mask itself felt cool to wear, and the texture was soft and comfortable. The scent is light and not overpowering. I put it on at night before bed and peeled it off in the middle of the night, so I wore it for about 3 to 5 hours. When I got up in the morning, my face felt a little irritated. Over the span of the day, it became more itchy and even a little red. I rinsed my face off a couple of times, and it did not alleviate the itchy feeling. After using soap and water, my face felt smooth and no longer itchy. My face did feel softer than normal, so that might have been from the facemask. When I peeled it off, the mask was clear and dry. Supposedly the mask "turns clear when your skin absorbs the material", but the mask will turn clear if you leave it out as well, so that talking point I've seen on Tiktok may not be completely accurate. Anything you put on your skin will be absorbed. TL;DR: If you have sensitive skin, or are trying the product for the first time, wear it for the recommended 3 hours or even less, not overnight.
